name: io.github.SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp-server-pro
description: Enterprise-ready portable memory for AI agents: encrypted, shareable, provably erased. Join SAIHM.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_ENDPOINT_URL
environmentVariables.description: SAIHM operator endpoint. Optional: defaults to the hosted service at https://saihm.coti.global/mcp.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_SELF_JOIN
environmentVariables.description: Self-join is ON by default: the saihm_join tool generates a non-custodial identity on this device and activates the free trial, so no master secret is needed. Set to '0' to suppress the tool.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_MASTER_SECRET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a mode-600 file holding a 64+ hex-char master secret. Only needed if you opt out of self-join or are restoring an existing identity. Never transmitted.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Base dir for the self-join identity file ($SAIHM_HOME/free-identity.key, mode 600). Defaults to ~/.saihm. Also the fallback state directory when SAIHM_STATE_DIR is unset.
